sources_used: Qiagen N.V. FY20-FY24 Annual Reports + Q1-Q3 2025 (https://corporate.qiagen.com/investors)
_ordering_rationale: Qiagen Life Sciences : Sample Tech (KPI maitre #1 mondial sample prep), Diagnostic Solutions, QuantiFERON (TB test), Consumables mix, EBIT margin.

kpis.signal: #1 mondial sample preparation, segment historique haute marge, croissance soutenue
kpis.description_fr: CA Sample Technologies (kits préparation échantillon ADN/ARN/protéines). Leader mondial historique Qiagen, ~37% du CA.
kpis.description_en: Sample Technologies revenue (DNA/RNA/protein sample prep kits). Qiagen's historic global leader, ~37% of revenue.

kpis.signal: QuantiFERON-TB (test tuberculose latente) leader mondial, QIAstat-Dx (PCR syndromique) en expansion
kpis.description_fr: CA Diagnostic Solutions (QuantiFERON-TB latent tuberculosis test + QIAstat-Dx PCR multiplex). QuantiFERON = standard or mondial TB.
kpis.description_en: Diagnostic Solutions revenue (QuantiFERON-TB latent tuberculosis test + QIAstat-Dx multiplex PCR). QuantiFERON = global TB gold standard.

kpis.signal: Croissance double digit soutenue, conversion mondiale du test cutané (TST) vers IGRA + nouvelle plateforme QFT Access (POC)
kpis.description_fr: CA produit QuantiFERON-TB (test sanguin IGRA pour tuberculose latente). Bestseller Qiagen, conversion progressive du TST historique vers IGRA dans le monde.
kpis.description_en: QuantiFERON-TB revenue (IGRA blood test for latent tuberculosis). Qiagen bestseller, gradual global conversion from TST skin test to IGRA.

kpis.signal: Normalisation post-Covid (PCR instruments + assays), retour croissance organique
kpis.description_fr: CA PCR Solutions (instruments PCR Rotor-Gene + assays). Forte décrue post-Covid (2020-22), retour à la croissance.
kpis.description_en: PCR Solutions revenue (Rotor-Gene PCR instruments + assays). Strong post-Covid decline (2020-22), returning to growth.

kpis.signal: Bioinformatique (CLC Genomics + Ingenuity), services NGS, expansion oncologie + immunologie
kpis.description_fr: CA Genomics/NGS (bioinformatique CLC + Ingenuity + services NGS). Pilier futur via QIAseq + analyse données génomiques.
kpis.description_en: Genomics/NGS revenue (CLC bioinformatics + Ingenuity + NGS services). Future pillar via QIAseq + genomic data analysis.

kpis.signal: Cible >31% à moyen terme, levier mix + discipline coûts
kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle ajustée Qiagen. Cible >31% via mix consumables/instruments + automatisation production.
kpis.description_en: Qiagen adjusted operating margin. Target >31% via consumables/instruments mix + production automation.

_notes: Qiagen FY = calendaire. Sources : Annual Reports FY20-FY24 + Q1-Q3 2025 results.
